description: Format a professional business letter in WPS Writer. Open /home/ga/Documents/draft_letter.docx which contains the raw text of a job application letter to Microsoft Corporation. Apply proper business letter formatting: (1) Add sender address at the top (Emily Chen, 425 Pike Street, Seattle, WA 98101), (2) Add the date below the sender address (format: January 15, 2024), (3) Add recipient address (Ms. Kathleen Hogan, Chief People Officer, Microsoft Corporation, One Microsoft Way, Redmond, WA 98052), (4) Make the salutation 'Dear Ms. Hogan:' bold, (5) Set the body paragraphs to justified alignment with single line spacing, (6) Make the closing 'Sincerely,' italic, (7) Add a signature line with the sender's name below the closing. Save the document (Ctrl+S).
